subject: Atlas Workshop — airport hub swap & boarding-group reassignment
messages:
From: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@novum.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, TravelOps <ops@traveldesk.co>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request — earlier arrival for Novum execs (Atlas)

Hannah / TravelOps,

Quick note — our execs have asked to arrive a few hours earlier on the day before the Atlas workshop due to a board dinner that got moved up. Can you confirm whether we can swap the inbound legs for the Novum delegation to an earlier arrival into SFO (ideally landing by 16:00 local) and keep them on the same ground-transfer manifest? We need to keep the three leads together (Hayes / Boudreaux / Lin) and preserve aisle/window seating preferences if possible.

Key constraints:
- One lead (Boudreaux) requires bulkhead or extra legroom.
- Two delegates are on award tickets — avoid reissuing if possible.
- Travel budget is flexible for upgrades if necessary, but prefer no multi-segment PNR splits.

I can be on a quick call if helpful. Thanks — Tom

--
Tom Hayes
Head of Partnerships, Novum Systems
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: TravelOps <ops@traveldesk.co>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — earlier arrival for Novum execs (Atlas)

Thanks Tom — looping in TravelOps to handle PNR changes. TravelOps: please review the existing PNRs (Novum delegation) and propose the minimal-change option that gets the three leads into SFO by ~16:00 local 6/14. Priorities in order: 1) keep leads on one PNR, 2) bulkhead/extra-legroom for Boudreaux, 3) avoid reissuing award tickets if it forces a split. If the only realistic option is to change carriers/route that forces a PNR split, flag cost/penalty and show an alternate that gives the same-day earlier arrival.

Also: we may need to reassign boarding groups so the leads board together (avoid one being in a later group due to seat class changes). If there are premium upgrade costs, note who bears charge (Novum pre-approved up to $350 per person).

Dev — FYI, please confirm we can still meet the 09:00 workshop start on 6/15 with a 16:00 SFO arrival for the group, accounting for ground transfer and hotel check-in.

Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Customer Events | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, TravelOps <ops@traveldesk.co>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request — earlier arrival for Novum execs (Atlas)

Hannah — quick confirmation: 16:00 SFO arrival is fine for our timeline. Ground transfer departs hotel at 06:30 the next morning, and we have a 75-minute buffer for check-in + internal brief. Bulkhead for Boudreaux is preferred — if TravelOps can secure it without breaking award tickets that'd be ideal. If we end up splitting PNRs, prioritize keeping the three leads on the same shuttle manifest even if seats differ.

One small ask: if there is a chance to move any of the delegation to an earlier redeye arriving before 12:00, please list it as an alternate but don't auto-apply.

Thanks — Dev
From: TravelOps <ops@traveldesk.co>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@novum.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Updated options + boarding-manifest (Novum delegation)

Team — thanks for the details. We evaluated three routing options; below is the summary and attached files. We prioritized minimal PNR changes and kept the three leads together where feasible.

Option A (preferred): Rebook one connecting leg on existing carrier (no award reissue) — new ETA SFO 15:48 local. Keeps all three leads on same PNR; bulkhead for Boudreaux secured (seat 4C, extra-legroom). No additional fare difference.

Option B: Move two delegates to an earlier redeye (arrive 11:50) to create buffer — requires one award reissue (fees apply).

Option C: Re-route via different carrier (same-day earlier arrival 14:35) — forces PNR split and $420 reissue; keeps shuttle manifest intact but boarding-group alignment will require paid upgrades for two seats.

We applied Option A as a provisional hold and attached: zenith_updated_pnr.pdf (provisional itinerary + PNR locator) and boarding_manifest.csv (manifests with boarding-group assignments). The provisional hold expires in 18 hours.

Notes / action items:
- Please confirm which option to finalize. If you approve Option A, we will ticket the change and send final boarding passes (PDFs).
- If you want Option C, confirm charging instruction: Novum or Redwood? Tom noted pre-approval up to $350 — Option C exceeds that by $70 per person.

Attachments: zenith_updated_pnr.pdf (provisional PNR), boarding_manifest.csv (csv)

Regards,
Lena Ruiz
Senior Agent, TravelOps (TravelDesk)
ops@traveldesk.co | +1 888-555-0210
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: TravelOps <ops@traveldesk.co>
Cc: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@novum.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Updated options + boarding-manifest (Novum delegation)

Lena / TravelOps — Option A approved. Please proceed to ticket the change and send final boarding passes to the Novum delegation and copy our team. Confirm that bulkhead (4C) for Boudreaux is ticketed and reflected in the final manifest.

Tom — we'll cover any up to $350 per person; TravelOps will flag overages. If Option A holds and tickets are issued, please confirm Novum will accept the provisional seat assignments.

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround on this.

Hannah
